method: Retained RE VM Ghidra 12.1.2 BE-instruction/LE-data pseudo-disassembly. Callees skipped assuming return; selected state cases stop at common redispatch 0xf000ee30.

initialization.selected_case: incoming mode 2 branches at 0xf000e7d8 to 0xf000e7fa; pool call is reachable in this case.

command_object_path.ingress: 0xf004d928 calls 0xf000b230 at 0xf004d978, then calls command dispatcher 0xf000f3a8 at 0xf004d9c8 or queues the same object.
command_object_path.getter: 0xf000b230 selects head 0xf007418c or 0xf006c7b8 by its second argument; neither is native RX head 0xf0073680. It unlinks and decrements selected head+8, clears 92-byte object and binds descriptor through ROM table 0x1b554.
command_object_path.dispatch: 0xf000f3a8 searches 81 entries starting 0xf005e8cc, with CID 0xc0 leading to the previously selected query handler 0xf000e4e4.
command_object_path.query: Handler saves the input object and builds the reply in its existing object+8 buffer; ordinary RAM query loads the requested word. No new object allocation identified in this handler.
command_object_path.reply: 0xf00265e8 hands the input object to 0xf0026468; the latter calls ROM table 0x1b4a0 then retires the same object through 0xf000bbe4 with argument 0.
command_object_path.conclusion: Selected command path uses other fixed pools and shared retirement. No direct native-pool metadata mutation identified along these selected paths. This is not proof that queries have no indirect or ROM-side effects.

limitations: Immediate pairs, aligned pointers and direct flow searches miss aliases, computed targets and ROM paths.
Graphs from case entries without a stop boundary reach the redispatch loop and other modes; these were unsuitable for per-case claims and replaced by bounded local case graphs.
Live pool availability is not initialized-pool proof, continuous availability or RF reception; head/count reads are non-atomic.
Shared retirement and unmapped ROM effects prohibit attributing pool changes to RF packets.
sanitization: Raw firmware and private disassembly omitted; independent summaries, addresses and digests only.
